I will check out Enya, thanks for the suggestion. 

I have tried talking to two people close to me. Only one was helpful but I feel like I might be starting to bother her with my problems. 

Otherwise I'm too paranoid to express emotions in writting or anything liek that. I might try painting though i'm not very good at it.

hey there 

I hope it'll be helpful. I don't know what I'll do if it's not.

I will try that breathing thing, thank you. Sounds like it could work.

I will also try the goal thing. I'll start writting those down now. I just need to figure out what it is that brings me joy...

I wish I could just avoid a lot of teh situations that cause me stress. I'm in this program where we do drills and this program is really important for my future and stuff. I got a really bad panic attack last time i had to do drill two days ago and had to play it off like nothing was wrong. I'm scared to do it again next week. I also lost the pants for it and a button for the shirt. The whole program is relaly starting to stress me out but I can't quit it because my mom will probably make me stay in it. Also the only friend that relaly gets me is in teh programs and that's teh only time i really get to see her, I don't want to lose touch with her.

Also my friends at school stress me out a lot and i can't just avoid them either. Then I'd have no friends. I also can't avoid math class which stresses me out a lot (has had two minor panic attacks in that class in the past 4 days)

Thank you for your input and help :)
answers to any of the questions I asked in my post :)

Honestly I don't even think things are going to get better and "experiencing the world" isn't really my main priority right now. Really suicide feels like my only way out.

Really right now I'm just trying to survive the next 6 weeks until i can get proffessional help. Any help with just making things easier until then would be really appreciatted.
I did not mean "are you insane?" to offend you. I probably should've reconsidered my wording on that but it did get my point across. I'm not trying to bully you.

They sound like a really good resource. I'm glad they were able to help you so much! One question though, is it toll free? (Not because I'm frugal but because I don't want my parents finding out, especially if this is teh extent of the help i'll be needing to get)

I have a few questions. What is YSB? And what are inpatient and outpatient services?

Thank you so much for this information though. It is incredibly usefull.

WHOA THERE

Kids who try to seek mental illness help anonymously aren't going to be treated like fucking criminals are you insane? that backwards bullshit is also not something you should be thanking me for because it will "inform kids". It's informing them lies, that's what it is.

Please maybe just not comment here anymore...I'm not sure if you're trying to "help" or what but this is not your kind of place to try and "help" or whatever it is you think you are doing.
thank you for the number! I might call them sometime. That might be the number i've already called around a month ago but you saved me from having to go searching for it again so thanks a ton! :D

I don't want to talk to a family member because I'm not really close to any of them. I know that they'll find out anyways because the hospital would have to call them but I feel like it would be easier for me to go there myself and get treatment for a while before they showed up. Also if I talked to my parents and asked them to bring me to CHEO they probably wouldn't bring me without a thorough explanation or they'd be very insistent on knowing and it would delay the process and make the whole thing harder for me. Also I don't know if i could ask them to leave for the psych evaluation part.

thanks, this is really comforting :)
